purpose_context: Operator ruling 2 of 2026-10-31 (#6117) asks for an optional spec-kitty-services platform wheel that carries the pinned, digest-verified write and charter service binaries and fills the reserved spec_kitty.service_binaries slot, so teams can install the full stack offline in one command. The main spec-kitty-cli wheel keeps shipping pins only and fetching on first use. Tracked by #6904.
purpose_tldr: Offer a one-command offline install of the service binaries through an optional companion wheel, while the main CLI wheel stays pure.
